actions.action: Wipe wound edges with alcohol or hydrogen peroxide on a cotton swab
Trim loose hanging tissue with a sterilized blade if present
Check wound every few days for signs of rot
Place plant in bright, airy indirect light with good air movement
Plant in fast-draining cactus/succulent mix once wound is dry
Give a few days of partial shade before full sun after planting

reason: The answer correctly identifies minor mechanical thorn damage on an otherwise healthy plant, and its main advice to keep the leaf dry while it calluses matches the fix; the optional wound cleaning and rot checks are mild and not harmful.
